column1: # Panel event gelombang 9 — Targeted Procurement: Doll.
# Varian ini memakai "Neural Clouds" (bukan Neural Archives) dan
# "Redundant Fragments" — keduanya nama item, tetap Inggris.
=Targeted Procurement: Doll is a limited-time Doll Access event.
column2: Targeted Procurement: Doll adalah event Doll Access waktu terbatas.

column1: ^<color=#f26c1c>※ During the event, the limited Elite Dolls (.+) can only be obtained in the \[Targeted Procurement: Doll\] event\.$
column2: <color=#f26c1c>※ Selama event, Elite Doll terbatas \1 hanya bisa didapat di event [Targeted Procurement: Doll].

column1: =- Elite Doll Probability Instructions

=In this type of Access, the base probability of obtaining an Elite Doll is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, and the comprehensive probability of obtaining an Elite Doll (including the guarantee) is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.
column2: Di tipe Access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Elite Doll adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL1]</color>, dan probabilitas menyeluruh mendapat Elite Doll (termasuk jaminan) adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL2]</color>.

column1: =In this type of Access, the base probability of obtaining a Standard Doll or Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>.
column2: Di tipe Access ini, probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Doll atau Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL3]</color>.

column1: =The base probability of obtaining a Standard Doll is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>, and the probability of obtaining each Standard Doll is the same.
column2: Probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Doll adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL4]</color>, dan probabilitas mendapat tiap Standard Doll adalah sama.

column1: =The base probability of obtaining a Standard Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>, and the probability of obtaining each Standard Weapon is the same.
column2: Probabilitas dasar mendapat Standard Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL5]</color>, dan probabilitas mendapat tiap Standard Weapon adalah sama.

column1: =The comprehensive probability of obtaining a Standard Doll or Weapon (including the guarantee) is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.
column2: Probabilitas menyeluruh mendapat Standard Doll atau Weapon (termasuk jaminan) adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL6]</color>.

column1: =In this type of Access, every 10 Accesses guarantees obtaining a Standard Doll or Weapon, or an Elite Doll.
column2: Di tipe Access ini, tiap 10 Access dijamin mendapat Standard Doll atau Weapon, atau Elite Doll.

column1: =The base probability for a Standard Doll is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL7]</color> (comprehensive probability including guarantee: <color=#AC65E8>[VAL8]</color>), the base probability for a Standard Weapon is <color=#AC65E8>[VAL9]</color> (comprehensive probability including guarantee: <color=#AC65E8>[VAL10]</color>), and the base probability for an Elite Doll is <color=#EDA51C>[VAL11]</color> (comprehensive probability including guarantee: <color=#EDA51C>[VAL12]</color>).
column2: Probabilitas dasar Standard Doll adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL7]</color> (probabilitas menyeluruh termasuk jaminan: <color=#AC65E8>[VAL8]</color>), probabilitas dasar Standard Weapon adalah <color=#AC65E8>[VAL9]</color> (probabilitas menyeluruh termasuk jaminan: <color=#AC65E8>[VAL10]</color>), dan probabilitas dasar Elite Doll adalah <color=#EDA51C>[VAL11]</color> (probabilitas menyeluruh termasuk jaminan: <color=#EDA51C>[VAL12]</color>).

column1: =In this type of Access, if an Elite Doll is not obtained in 58 consecutive Accesses, the probability of obtaining an Elite Doll will increase.
column2: Di tipe Access ini, kalau Elite Doll tidak didapat dalam 58 Access berturut-turut, probabilitas mendapat Elite Doll akan naik.

column1: =Starting from the next Access, the probability will increase by <color=#EDA51C>[VAL13]</color> each time.
column2: Mulai Access berikutnya, probabilitasnya naik <color=#EDA51C>[VAL13]</color> tiap kali.

column1: =Every 80 Accesses guarantees obtaining an Elite Doll.
column2: Tiap 80 Access dijamin mendapat Elite Doll.

column1: =Whenever an Elite Doll is obtained, the count resets, and the probability of obtaining an Elite Doll reverts to the base probability.
column2: Tiap kali Elite Doll didapat, hitungannya direset dan probabilitas mendapat Elite Doll kembali ke probabilitas dasar.

column1: =If the Elite Doll obtained in this Access is not the Elite Doll with the probability increase for this period, the next Elite Doll obtained will definitely be the Elite Doll with the probability increase for this period.
column2: Kalau Elite Doll yang didapat di Access ini bukan Elite Doll yang probabilitasnya dinaikkan periode ini, Elite Doll berikutnya dipastikan yang probabilitasnya dinaikkan periode ini.

column1: =When obtaining duplicate Dolls through any means (including but not limited to Access, exchange, events, etc.), they will be converted according to the following rules:
column2: Saat mendapat Doll ganda lewat cara apa pun (termasuk tapi tidak terbatas pada Access, penukaran, event, dsb.), akan dikonversi menurut aturan berikut:

column1: =When obtaining a duplicate Standard Doll, the 2nd to 7th times it will be converted into 30 Neural Clouds for the corresponding Doll; obtaining it the 8th time and beyond will convert into 18 Redundant Fragments.
column2: Saat mendapat Standard Doll ganda, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Neural Clouds untuk Doll terkait; perolehan ke-8 dan seterusnya dikonversi jadi 18 Redundant Fragments.

column1: =When obtaining a duplicate Elite Doll, the 2nd to 7th times it will be converted into 30 Neural Clouds for the corresponding Doll; obtaining it the 8th time and beyond will convert into 90 Redundant Fragments.
column2: Saat mendapat Elite Doll ganda, perolehan ke-2 sampai ke-7 dikonversi jadi 30 Neural Clouds untuk Doll terkait; perolehan ke-8 dan seterusnya dikonversi jadi 90 Redundant Fragments.
